item.title: R for Repair: London x Singapore
item.description: 'R for Repair: London x Singapore' - the second edition of the 'R for Repair' exhibition - is open until November 2nd at the Victoria & Albert Museum in London. The exhibition showcases the transformative power of repair as part of the London Design Festival.

item.title: Whipsaw Recognized with Multiple Wins at 2022 IDEA
item.description: Whipsaw was recognized with multiple wins at the 2022 International Design Excellence Awards. Whipsaw won silver awards for its design of Fluidigm's Biomark X in the Medical & Health category and the MXXY Hydration Backpack in the Sports, Leisure & Recreation category.

item.title: Chez Pierre Restaurant in Monte Carlo by Vudafieri-Saverino Partners
item.description: Vudafieri-Saverino Partners has designed the Chez Pierre restaurant in Monte Carlo for Pierre Baldelli.

item.title: Blond Designs Reusable Fossil-fuel Free Packaging for Dizzie
item.description: Blond recently collaborated with zero waste grocery service Dizzie to launch its reusable fossil-fuel-free packaging.

item.title: Thornberg & Forester Adapts Ray Dalio's Latest Book Into Animated Film
item.description: Thornberg & Forester created a 45-minute animated film for Principles for Dealing with the Changing World Order: Why Nations Succeed and Fail, a visual adaptation of billionaire hedge fund manager Ray Dalio's New York Times Best Seller of the same title.

item.title: Barro by Caterina Moretti for Graypants
item.description: Graypants has unveiled Barro, a pendant fixture designed by Caterina Moretti. Barro is made from clay pulled directly from the earth of Oaxaca, handcrafted, and colored with only the power of heat and smoke.

item.title: Foster + Partners Designs Coral-inspired Museum by the Red Sea
item.description: Foster + Partners has designed a state-of-the-art marine life institute for the Red Sea Development Company (TRSDC), the developer behind the world's most ambitious regenerative tourism projects.

item.title: The Faces Behind Typefaces: Deep Dive into Legacies of Pioneers of Type Design
item.description: Readymag, in collaboration with Type Directors Club, has released a web project The Faces Behind Typefaces, featuring a selection of insightful conversations about typographers who have made extraordinary contributions to the creative field - Paula Scher, Paul Rand, Gerard Unger, Ed Benguiat, Rubén Fontana, Emigre, and Adrian Frutiger.

item.title: PAD London 2022
item.description: PAD London, the internationally acclaimed fair for design, returns to Berkeley Square in Mayfair for its 14th edition, running from October 10 to 16, 2022.

item.title: Prague Marriott Renovation Weaves Czech Cubism into its Renewed Interiors
item.description: twenty2degrees recently completed an extensive refurbishment of the Prague Marriott together with the design of a new wing which has almost doubled the conference and meeting areas and added 135 guestrooms and suites.
